# GraphFlow

> GraphFlow is a browser-based distributed systems modeler with a live simulation. You draw services, queues, caches and databases, push simulated traffic through them, inject faults, and watch latency, saturation, backpressure, circuit breakers and dead-letter routing happen in real time. It runs in the browser with no install and no sign-in to try.

GraphFlow is for backend and platform engineers who design or own distributed systems: design reviews, incident retrospectives and capacity planning. Static diagram tools (draw.io, Lucidchart, Excalidraw, Miro) draw boxes and lines; GraphFlow simulates packets along every edge with per-node latency, failure probability and capacity.

## Try it

- [Live studio](https://graph-flow-virid.vercel.app/?studio=1): open the simulator.
- [Stripe-style webhook and double-entry ledger](https://graph-flow-virid.vercel.app/?template=stripe-webhook-ledger): example topology.
- [Edge streaming under chaos](https://graph-flow-virid.vercel.app/?template=netflix-chaos-streaming): example topology.
- [CQRS with a Kafka outbox](https://graph-flow-virid.vercel.app/?template=resilient-cqrs-outbox): example topology.

## System design interview practice

Classic interview questions as runnable topologies. Each one names an experiment that exposes its bottleneck.

- [Design a URL shortener](https://graph-flow-virid.vercel.app/?template=interview-url-shortener)
- [Design a Twitter news feed (fan-out on write)](https://graph-flow-virid.vercel.app/?template=interview-news-feed)
- [Design WhatsApp (chat)](https://graph-flow-virid.vercel.app/?template=interview-chat)
- [Design a rate limiter](https://graph-flow-virid.vercel.app/?template=interview-rate-limiter)
- [Design Uber (ride sharing)](https://graph-flow-virid.vercel.app/?template=interview-ride-sharing)

## What it does

- Model an architecture on an infinite canvas and stress it with a load slider and per-node fault injection.
- Import docker-compose.yml, Terraform, draw.io, Excalidraw and Mermaid diagrams.
- Export Mermaid, SVG/PNG, Terraform, Kubernetes manifests and k6 load-test scripts. Some exports are Pro.
- Share by link or iframe embed.

## Pricing
